steps.description: Pre-filter genes to those with at least 10 counts in at least 6 samples (the smallest group size). Build DESeqDataSet with design ~ batch + condition, setting condition's reference level explicitly to 'control'. Run DESeq() (Wald test), extract results() for the contrast condition treated vs control with BH adjustment and independent filtering at alpha=0.05, then apply apeglm shrinkage to the condition coefficient's log2FoldChange. Flag any gene with an NA p-value from Cook's distance outlier detection separately from independent-filtering NAs.

plan.title: Kidney treated vs control DE with batch adjustment
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is 12 kidney samples (6 treated, 6 control), raw salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples per metadata/counts) with two known processing batches balanced across condition. Because batch is balanced across condition (not confounded), the correct approach is to include batch as a fixed-effect covariate in the DESeq2 design (~batch + condition) rather than pre-adjusting counts, per the grounded procedure (R-0006, R-0012). The workflow: (1) QC sample structure via blind-VST PCA/heatmap to confirm batch does not dominate variance and no sample is an outlier; (2) minimal low-count pre-filter; (3) DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization inside the ~batch+condition model; (4) Wald test on the condition coefficient (explicit reference level = control) with apeglm shrinkage of the treated-vs-control log2FC; (5) BH-adjusted results at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering and p-value histogram diagnostic; (6) preranked fgsea on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (primary) and Reactome (secondary) human gene sets, both staged locally; (7) a consolidated report with fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), the DE gene table (unshrunken and shrunken LFC), enrichment tables with leading-edge genes, and a full reproducibility record. No translational/clinical framing (drug targets, biomarkers, PK/PD, immune profiling) is warranted — the research question is a plain DE contrast with a batch covariate.

fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome
DE + enrichment report with diagnostics, reproducibility record
